name: Lordinals
description:
Lordinals brings the dawn of Bitcoin's on-chain history to life in 3D. Each piece
wraps one of the very first inscriptions ever carved into Bitcoin — the genesis
artifacts of Ordinals — reimagined as a fully-realized 3D model. Season One opens
a journey to wrap the first 1,000 inscriptions ever made, released season by season
and forged in a variety of ways.
